image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a guenon monkey (likely a Blue Monkey or similar species) sitting in grass. The monkey has dark grey/black fur on its body and limbs, with a lighter grey/white chest and facial ruff. Its face is bare-skinned with a greenish-grey tint, forward-facing eyes, and a narrow nose. The background is a soft-focus green forest environment. There is faint text 'myvid' in the top left corner.
